registers.name: GICR_IPRIORITYR<n>
registers.description: Interrupt Priority Registers。GIC Redistributor (GICR) 寄存器

fields.name: Priority_offset_3B
fields.description: IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED 范围内中断优先级值，字节偏移 3. 优先级值越小，中断优先级越高. 对于配置为不可屏蔽的中断 INTID，此字段为 RES0。
